Subject: Can't accept supplier portal invite (Coupa)

Hi Olga,

We received the supplier portal invite but when I try to accept it I get an error that says "Claim could not be completed: email mismatch". I clicked the link from the invite email and attached is a screenshot of the error message.

Our finance team needs to submit a PO today; they can't proceed until my account is claimed. For context: our org uses two aliases — elena@sunnyvalesupply.com is the public alias; my primary SSO account is elena.park@sunnyvalesupply.com. The invite appears to be bound to the public alias and Coupa redirects my SSO login to the primary address, causing the claim to fail.

Attached: screenshot-claim-error.png, w9-sunnyvale-signed.pdf

Could you reissue the invite or advise a workaround?

Thanks — Elena

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick note and the screenshots, that helps.

Short answer: it looks like the invite token is tied to the email on the PO (elena@sunnyvalesupply.com) while your corporate SSO claims are for elena.park@sunnyvalesupply.com. Coupa's tenant mapping refuses the claim because the post-SSO email doesn't match the token's address.

Two immediate options:
- I can reissue the claim to the SSO principal (elena.park@sunnyvalesupply.com) and generate a one-time claim link you can use.
- Or, as a manual workaround, you can accept the invite using incognito + when prompted choose "Use different account" and enter the alias that matches the invite (if your IdP allows it).

To reissue safely I need to confirm the exact SSO email you log in with and the tenant name. Can you confirm:
1) Which email you use to sign into your corporate SSO (exact spelling)
2) The tenant / IdP domain (e.g., azure.sunnyvalesupply.com) if known

Ill also loop in Marcus for an ops-side override in case we need to swap the invite binding.

—Olga
